contract.domain: deterministic directed patch/cell neighbourhood graph operating on accepted P3.2 next_biomass_kg outputs
contract.topology: unique non-self directed edges between known patch IDs; canonical from/to order; positive finite relative edge weights normalized per source
contract.weight_semantics: common positive scaling of all outgoing weights from one source is semantically neutral because only normalized shares are canonicalized
contract.dispersal_fraction: single bounded [0,1] research transfer fraction applied uniformly without plant/species winner lookup
contract.boundary_export: per-patch bounded [0,1] fraction of the dispersal pool routed to an explicit outside-system sink
contract.isolated_patch: internal dispersal pool is retained when no outgoing internal neighbours exist; explicit boundary export may still leave the system
contract.colonization: incoming biomass may introduce a plant ID absent from the destination source patch; biomass is transferred, not created
contract.conservation: total source biomass == total final in-patch biomass + explicit boundary export within 1e-12; total incoming == total internal transfer within 1e-12
contract.rng: kernel consumes no global or simulation RNG
contract.production_boundary: research graph-transfer kernel only; no server region ownership, persistence, environment gradient, seasonality or production migration authority

next_if_passes: accept P3.3, then open P3.4 Environmental Gradient
observer_note: OBS1 remains non-gating; multi-patch visualization can consume future read-only P3.3 snapshots but cannot own topology or mutation
